video_title: Adam Silver previews new NBA season

quotes.speaker: Adam Silver
quotes.summary_phrase: Adam Silver on the New York Knicks' 53-year championship drought
quotes.excerpt: so few things bring people together these days and sports is one of those things
quotes.quote: So few things bring people together these days and sports is one of those things. We're both in New York and it's been amazing just since June on that there continues to be this glow of good feeling around that team. It feels like everywhere I go, people are talking about the 53 years, people are saying I wish my granddad or one of my parents, my favorite line is all the 20-year-olds who say, we waited 53 years.

quotes.speaker: Adam Silver
quotes.summary_phrase: Adam Silver on LeBron James' longevity and performance at age 42
quotes.excerpt: the fact that even he'll be 42 later this year that he's playing as a top All-Star
quotes.quote: He's been around for 24 of those 25 seasons. The fact that even he'll be 42 later this year that he's playing as a top All-Star in the league at that age is quite incredible. It's a testament to his work ethic and just his body of work over the years.

quotes.speaker: Adam Silver
quotes.summary_phrase: Adam Silver on Victor Wembanyama's development and growth
quotes.excerpt: I think he's learning every year he keeps getting better
quotes.quote: I mean what a great series last year with the Knicks. I think he's learning every year he keeps getting better. I think somebody's saying he may even be getting taller. It's quite remarkable.

quotes.speaker: Adam Silver
quotes.summary_phrase: Adam Silver on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's development in Oklahoma City
quotes.excerpt: another still pretty young player out there who's learning how to win at the highest level
quotes.quote: SGA in Oklahoma City again, another still pretty young player out there who's learning how to win at the highest level. It's great to see these guys competing the way they are. It's a great style of basketball. I mean these are all-in players as you know with incredible work ethics, they love the game.

quotes.speaker: Adam Silver
quotes.summary_phrase: Adam Silver on NBA parity and the competitive landscape
quotes.excerpt: eight different champions over the last eight years it says so much about the level of competition
quotes.quote: Eight different champions over the last eight years. It says so much about the level of competition and the parity in this league. It's why I think this is one of the most anticipated seasons because there's so many teams that believe they have a shot this year. And as I say when you add that global pool of talent, there's so much talent out there.
